independence_limit: Held-out nodes are absent from the LUT and are recomputed in fresh PyTMatrix processes, but use the same PyTMatrix engine, generator, dielectric assumptions, orientation, geometry, and fall-speed closures. This tests generation and interpolation only; it is not independent scientific validation.
selection_protocol: Coordinates were fixed before direct-node results were generated. Every point is absent from the LUT grid and lies strictly inside every non-singleton axis used for interpolation.
unmet_production_gates: independent Mie sphere comparison across the configured materials
independently coded PSD integration and terminal-moment comparison
independent covariance phase and radar H/V basis verification
independent KDP and attenuation convention/unit verification
reviewed wet-particle dielectric and morphology validation
